camel_example: aliyun domain UpdateDomainToDomainGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Replace false --DomainGroupId 1234 --DataSource 1 --version 2018-01-29 --method POST --force
description_en: If you use file upload to replace more than 1,000 domain names in a domain name group, the operation is asynchronous. The result is available only after the request is processed
description_zh: 如使用文件上传，替换超过1000个域名的分组，则该操作属于异步操作，需等待系统处理后才能看到结果
name: UpdateDomainToDomainGroup

parameters.help_en: The user IP address. You can set this parameter to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of API error messages. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文；
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded content of a file. This parameter is required if you set DataSource to 2. The file must be in .xls or .xlsx format, contain one domain name per line, and not exceed 2 MB
parameters.help_zh: base64编码的xls、xlsx文件，域名来源为文件时该字段为必须。文件中每行一个域名，单次上传最大支持文件大小为2M
parameters.name: file_to_upload

parameters.help_en: The ID of the domain name group. Call the QueryDomainGroupList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.html) API to get this ID
parameters.help_zh: 分组编号，可通过QueryDomainGroupList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.html) 接口查询
parameters.name: domain_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to replace the existing domain names in the group. Valid values:

false: Adds the new domain names to the group.

true: Replaces all existing domain names in the group with the new ones
parameters.help_zh:
是否替换当前分组中域名。取值：
false：向分组中新增域名；
true：替换分组中原有域名
parameters.name: replace

parameters.help_en:
The data source for the domain names. Valid values:

1: custom input.

2: file upload
parameters.help_zh:
域名数据来源。取值：
1：自定义输入域名；
2：文件上传
parameters.name: data_source

parameters.help_en: An array of domain names. This parameter is required when DataSource is set to 1 (custom input)
parameters.help_zh: 自定义输入的域名，域名来源为自定义输入时，该字段为必须
parameters.name: domain_name
